sources.title: Bartholomeus on TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Bartholomeus ranks #1 of 237 restaurants in Knokke-Heist on TripAdvisor with 4.8/5.

sources.title: Hotel St. Yves
sources.claim: Hotel St. Yves, Zeedijk-Heist 204 — 3-star seafront hotel, 8 rooms.

sources.title: Hotel St. Yves price
sources.claim: Hotel St. Yves rooms start at roughly €100/night.

sources.title: Brasserie Bristol residences
sources.claim: Brasserie Bristol at Zeedijk 291 partners with three residences for stays.

sources.title: Residentie Bristol prices
sources.claim: Residentie Bristol on Zeedijk 290: studio €310 winter / €545 summer for a 2-night weekend.

sources.title: B&B Aquavit
sources.claim: B&B Aquavit, Sint-Jorisstraat 7: 2-room design boutique B&B, adults-only, 9.6/10.

sources.title: B&B Morpheus
sources.claim: B&B Morpheus at Zeetrapper 16, 2 rooms at €120/night, ~10-min walk to the Heist seafront.

sources.title: Hotel Britannia
sources.claim: Hotel Britannia, Elizabetlaan 85 in Het Zoute — 1928 Anglo-Norman villa, 26 rooms, renovated 2022.

sources.title: Marie Siska Boutique Hotel
sources.claim: Marie Siska Boutique Hotel — 7 rooms above the 1919 waffle house.

sources.title: Marie Siska history
sources.claim: Marie Siska family has baked waffles since 1882; Zoutelaan waffle house opened 1919.

sources.title: La Réserve Resort
sources.claim: La Réserve sits between the Zegemeer and the Grand Casino; top-floor wellness centre and indoor pool.

sources.title: La Réserve — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: La Réserve Resort, Knokke-Heist — 5-star, listed in the Michelin Guide hotels selection.

sources.title: Hotel Approach
sources.claim: Hotel Approach, Kustlaan 172 — 24 rooms, 75 m from the beach; all art and furnishings for sale.

sources.title: Manoir Carpe Diem
sources.claim: Romantik Manoir Carpe Diem — Belle Époque villa at Prins Karellaan 12, De Haan; 16 rooms, heated outdoor pool.

sources.title: B&B Pronkenburg
sources.claim: B&B Pronkenburg — 18th-c. farmhouse at Ter Doeststraat 30, Lissewege, antique/brocante interiors.

sources.title: Hotel Heritage Bruges (Relais & Châteaux)
sources.claim: Hotel Heritage Bruges — Relais & Châteaux, 1869 private mansion 50 m from Markt, 22 rooms.

sources.title: Hotel Heritage — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Heritage Bruges — Niklaas Desparsstraat 11, 8000 Brugge.

sources.title: Knokke taxi tariffs
sources.claim: Knokke taxi tariffs are municipally regulated; ~€14 for 5 km in 2026.

sources.title: Knokke→Bruges train times
sources.claim: Knokke→Bruges direct train: 21 min, 17 km, ~22 trains/day.

sources.title: Bruges Belfort
sources.claim: Belfort admission €15 (2026); open daily 09:00–20:00 high season.

sources.title: Musea Brugge — Belfort
sources.claim: Belfort is 83 m tall with 366 steps.

sources.title: De Halve Maan brewery
sources.claim: De Halve Maan — Classic Tour €16, 45 min, one beer; XL Tour weekends €26, 90 min, 3 beers.

sources.title: Bruges canal boats
sources.claim: Bruges canal boat tour: 30 min, €15 adult / €9 child, tickets only on the spot.

sources.title: Lissewege — VisitBruges
sources.claim: Lissewege — 'white polder village'; 13th-c. Gothic church with ~50 m tower.

sources.title: Ter Doest tithe barn
sources.claim: Ter Doest tithe barn (~1375), 50.5 m long — one of the last surviving medieval tithe barns.

sources.title: Het Zwin — tickets
sources.claim: Zwin Nature Park 2026: from €13.50 adult / €6 child (6–17); €1.50 off for online.

sources.title: Het Zwin — hours
sources.claim: Zwin opens daily 10:00–17:00 during Flemish school holidays and public holidays; weekends-only Jan-Feb.

sources.title: Het Zwin on BirdingPlaces
sources.claim: Het Zwin: 300+ recorded bird species; signature species include spoonbill, little egret, avocet, white stork.

sources.title: Sluis — Wikivoyage
sources.claim: Sluis shops open Sundays — uniquely in the area — closed only Christmas Day and New Year's.

sources.title: Sluis — Zeeland.com
sources.claim: Sluis: only Dutch town hall with a Flemish belfort; working windmill Molen de Brak houses a brasserie.

sources.title: Lamme Goedzak paddle steamer
sources.claim: Lamme Goedzak runs 4 Apr – 1 Nov 2026; 35 min one-way; €12 / €18 RT.

sources.title: Damme — VisitBruges
sources.claim: Damme: Damse Vaart lined with 100+ year-old poplars; Lamme Goedzak links Bruges' Noorweegse Kaai to Damme.

sources.title: Damme book town
sources.claim: Damme profiles itself as a book village; themed monthly book market on the second Sunday.

sources.title: Knokke→Damme cycling (Komoot)
sources.claim: Damse Vaart canal loop from Knokke: 81 km / 3h27 popular ride; one-way Knokke→Bruges ~38 km.

sources.title: De Haan Concessie
sources.claim: De Haan's Concessie was protected as a village landscape in 1995 — Belle Époque villa quarter.

sources.title: Einstein in De Haan
sources.claim: Einstein lived in exile at Shakespearelaan 5 in De Haan in 1933.

sources.title: Pure C — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Pure C — 2 Michelin stars, Sergio Herman, Strandhotel Cadzand-Bad.

sources.title: Knokke Casino — Magritte mural
sources.claim: Magritte's Le Domaine Enchanté at the Grand Casino — eight-panel 360° mural finished 1953.

sources.title: EUSIPCO 2026
sources.claim: EUSIPCO 2026 — 31 Aug – 4 Sep 2026 at Concertgebouw Brugge; ~600 attendees.

sources.title: Howest Digital Health Lab events
sources.claim: Howest Digital Health Lab — 'AI as a Partner in Motion' keynote, 9 June 2026, Campus Howest Brugge.

sources.title: Building Bruges meetup
sources.claim: Building Bruges — Bruges software developer meetup, ~575 members.

sources.title: De Lijn — Kusttram
sources.claim: Kusttram: 67 km, 68 stops, full Belgian coast Knokke ↔ De Panne; ~2h21 end-to-end.

sources.claim: Grand Casino Knokke — operator of the Magritte hall.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist beaches
sources.claim: Knokke-Heist's coast is split into four beaches — Heist, Duinbergen, Albertstrand, Het Zoute — and the promenade runs ~9 km.

sources.title: Sincfala Museum
sources.claim: Sincfala — museum of the Zwinstreek at Pannenstraat 134, Heist; 2,000 years of regional history, shrimp boat Jessica in the garden.

sources.title: Baai van Heist
sources.claim: Baai van Heist — 50+ ha of beach and dunes, rare passerine breeding habitat.

sources.title: Lichttorenplein
sources.claim: Lichttorenplein — reconstruction of the 1872 lighthouse demolished in 1954, pink-paved square.

sources.title: Baai van Heist — Wikipedia (NL)
sources.claim: Baai van Heist: 50 ha nature reserve since 1997, Natura 2000, created 1977–85 by sand accumulation behind Zeebrugge's breakwater.
